`CGEventCreateMouseEvent` takes a source, an event type, a point, and a mouse button. The types are fine-grained: `kCGEventLeftMouseDown`, `kCGEventLeftMouseUp`, `kCGEventRightMouseDown`, `kCGEventMouseMoved`, `kCGEventLeftMouseDragged`, and so on; the button is `kCGMouseButtonLeft` and friends. - A **click** is move-to-position, down, up. - A **drag** is move, down, one or more moved/dragged events, up. - A **double-click** is not two fast clicks — the system decides "double" from the click-count field on the event. • unreal/framework/enhanced-input.md — Enhanced Input for Builders / Purpose
Enhanced Input is Unreal Engine 5's input system and the only one Helena should generate. The old Project Settings action/axis mappings are deprecated. Instead of keys wired straight to functions, Enhanced Input splits input into three layers: what the player wants (Input Actions, data assets), which keys produce those wants in which situation (Input Mapping Contexts), and when they fire (triggers) plus how raw values get shaped (modifiers). Helena generates the whole chain — actions, contexts, bindings, priorities — from the game's control list.
